    per = ops.clamp(per, 0.0, per_clip)
    return per.mean()

A bounded additive shift beta*dz injects an external objective gap (delta_z or cost_a - cost_b). When the objective gap is defined as winner-minus-loser, swapping winner/loser flips both d and dz, preserving antisymmetry of the effective margin.
